run_visualizer_cli: run the visualizer CLI to stream RGB and depth images from a Spot robot camera
run_visualizer_intel_realsense: run the visualizer with --intel flag to use Intel Realsense camera sources on Spot
run_visualizer_socket_verify: run the visualizer with --verify-with-socket to compare gRPC images against ZeroMQ socket images
create_image_response_to_cv2: create a function that converts a BosDyn image response protobuf into an OpenCV numpy array with optional rotation
create_get_image_responses: create a function that retrieves images from Spot cameras by source list with optional quality or pixel format parameters
create_get_realsense_images: create a function that fetches RGB and depth images from Intel Realsense or default Spot hand cameras
create_plot_images: create a function that displays color and depth images side by side using OpenCV with a depth colormap overlay
create_get_images_from_socket: create a function that receives RGB and depth image buffers from a ZeroMQ socket and reshapes them into numpy arrays
review_image_response_to_cv2: review the image_response_to_cv2 function that handles raw and encoded image format conversion with reorientation
refactor_get_image_responses: refactor the get_image_responses function to support additional image request parameters beyond quality and pixel format
